name: National Museum of the Great Lakes, 1701 Front St
refs: refs/w421852806/00 (Front Entrance of The National Museum of the Great Lakes in Toledo, Ohio, October 2019, Wikimedia Commons)
notes: Former International Park pavilion: tan split-face block walls on a dark stone base, a square entrance tower with a full-height glazed arch and a glass lantern under a dark hipped metal roof, ribbon windows and a railed roof terrace.
